title: Load rooms tab with active filter (default)
steps: Authenticate as a user with service_management:read and appointment_management:read
Wait for the rooms query to resolve
expected: Table renders with Active pill selected, rows visible, search bar present, Create Room button visible if user has appointment_management:create

title: Create room — golden path
steps: Select a branch from the combobox
expected: Dialog closes, success toast 'Room created successfully', room appears in the table

title: Edit room — golden path
steps: Click 'Edit' on any active room row
Verify the form pre-populates with room data
expected: Dialog closes, success toast 'Room updated successfully', table reflects updated name

title: Deactivate room — golden path
steps: Verify confirmation dialog shows room name
expected: Dialog closes, toast 'Room "<name>" deactivated', room disappears from Active list
selectorHints: getByText(/Are you sure you want to deactivate/)

title: Reactivate room — golden path
steps: Click 'Reactivate' on any inactive room row
expected: Dialog closes, toast 'Room "<name>" reactivated', room disappears from Inactive list

title: Filter switch — Active → All → Inactive
expected: Each filter switch refires the rooms query with the correct isActive parameter; table content updates accordingly

title: Create room — Name field empty (client validation)
expected: Toast error 'Name is required'; dialog stays open; no API call made

title: Create room — Name is only whitespace (client validation)
expected: Toast error 'Name is required'; dialog stays open; no API call made (client trims to empty string)

title: Create room — Type not selected (client validation)
steps: Fill Name and Capacity and Branch, leave Type unselected
expected: Toast error 'Type is required'; dialog stays open

title: Create room — Capacity = 0 (client validation)
expected: Toast error 'Capacity must be at least 1'; dialog stays open

title: Create room — Capacity negative (client validation)
expected: Toast error 'Capacity must be at least 1'; dialog stays open

title: Create room — Capacity is decimal string (edge: parseInt truncates)
expected: parseInt truncates to 1; room is created with capacity 1 (no error shown). Risk: user intent was 2.

title: Create room — Branch not selected (client validation)
steps: Fill Name, Type, Capacity but do not select a branch
expected: Toast error 'Branch is required'; dialog stays open

title: Create room — server rejects (permission denied)
steps: As a user whose role lacks appointment_management:create, open Create Room dialog via direct DOM manipulation
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN (403); useApiMutation shows toast with the error message; dialog remains open

title: Create room — server network error
steps: Open Create Room dialog with valid form data
expected: useApiMutation catches the error; toast.error shown with message; dialog stays open; Create button re-enabled

title: Edit room — toggle Active status via checkbox
expected: Room is updated with isActive: false; success toast; room disappears from Active filter list

title: Edit room — Active checkbox absent in Create mode
steps: Inspect the dialog for an Active checkbox
expected: No Active checkbox visible in Create mode; newly created rooms default to isActive: true

title: Edit room — Branch branch accessible RBAC rejection
steps: As a staff user scoped to Branch A, attempt to change a room's branch to Branch B (outside scope)
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN (guardBranchAccessible); useApiMutation shows toast error

title: No organisation context selected
expected: 'Select an organization to view rooms.' message shown; no query fires; no Create Room button
selectorHints: getByText('Select an organization to view rooms.')

title: Rooms list loading state
steps: Observe render while query is in-flight
expected: PageLoader spinner is displayed; no table content visible

title: Rooms list error state + retry
expected: Error panel with message shown; clicking 'Try Again' fires refetch()

title: Empty state with Create action
steps: Ensure the org has no rooms for the selected filter
expected: EmptyState renders with 'No rooms found', 'Create your first room to get started.', and 'Create Room' action button (if canCreate)

title: Empty state without Create action (read-only user)
steps: Log in as a user with appointment_management:read but not appointment_management:create
Navigate to rooms tab with no rooms for the filter
expected: EmptyState renders without the 'Create Room' action button

title: Search filters table client-side
steps: Type a partial room name in the search input
expected: Table rows filter immediately (no API call); non-matching rows disappear; clearing search restores all rows

title: Search yields no results — in-table empty state
steps: Type a search string that matches no room names
expected: Table body shows EmptyState with 'No results found' and context='search'

title: Name column sort
steps: Click the 'Name' column header button once (ascending sort)
expected: Rows sort alphabetically by name ascending then descending; no API call; sort icon toggles

title: Edit button is no-op for user without appointment_management:update
steps: Log in as a user with appointment_management:read but not appointment_management:update
expected: No dialog opens; button click silently ignored (empty function passed as onEdit)

title: Deactivate/Reactivate buttons visible to read-only user (permission gap)
steps: Log in as a user with appointment_management:read but not appointment_management:update
Click 'Deactivate' on an active room row
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN; toast error displayed. Buttons should ideally be hidden for read-only users but are currently always shown.

title: Deactivate cancellation
expected: Dialog closes; room remains active; no API call made

title: Deactivate — server network error
steps: Intercept /rpc/rooms/update to return a network error
expected: Dialog closes (finally block), toast.error shown with error message

title: No branches available — form shows warning message
steps: Ensure hierarchy nodes query returns no nodes with type='branch'
expected: Branch field shows 'No branches found. Create a branch first.' message; form cannot be submitted (branch required)
selectorHints: getByText('No branches found. Create a branch first.')

title: Hierarchy nodes query error — branches silently empty
expected: No error message about hierarchy failure; form shows 'No branches found'; user cannot distinguish network error from truly empty org. Risk: silent failure.
selectorHints: getByText('No branches found. Create a branch first.')

title: Branch combobox search filters options
expected: Dropdown filters to matching branch names; selecting one sets branchId; clearing input shows all again

title: Branch combobox search — no match
expected: Dropdown shows 'No branches found' message

title: Dialog backdrop click closes form without saving
expected: Dialog closes via onOpenChange(false) → closeSheet(); no API call; form state reset; no warning about unsaved changes

title: Create room — very large capacity value (no upper-bound guard)
expected: Room created with capacity 999999; no error. No upper-bound validation exists at either client or server layer.

title: Route-level permission denied redirect
steps: Log in as a user without service_management:read
expected: User is redirected to /dashboard?unauthorized=true before the page renders

title: Staff user sees only rooms in accessible branches
steps: Log in as a staff user scoped to Branch A only
expected: Only rooms whose branchId is within the staff member's accessibleNodeIds are returned; rooms in Branch B (outside scope) do not appear

title: Staff user sees all branches in combobox but cannot create in out-of-scope branch
steps: Log in as a staff user scoped to Branch A
Select Branch B (displayed in combobox despite being out of scope)
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN (guardBranchAccessible); toast error displayed. Combobox should ideally filter to accessible branches only.

title: Create button hidden for user without appointment_management:create
steps: Log in as a user with service_management:read and appointment_management:read only
expected: 'Create Room' button is not rendered in the action bar or in EmptyState

title: Rooms.delete procedure uses appointment_management:update permission
steps: Call rooms.delete via API with a user who has appointment_management:update but not a hypothetical appointment_management:delete
expected: Delete (soft deactivation) succeeds. There is no delete-specific permission; update is sufficient for both edit and delete operations.

title: Double-click Create Room button (race condition)
steps: Double-click 'Create Room' button rapidly before first response returns
expected: Button is disabled while isBusy=true (createMutation.isPending); second click should be ignored. Only one room should be created.

title: Deactivate room already inactive (server round-trip)
steps: In All filter, click Deactivate on a room that was just deactivated by another session (race condition)
expected: Server updateRoom fires; if room is already inactive, it sets isActive: false again idempotently. No error thrown.

title: Update non-existent room ID (server error)
steps: Craft a direct API call to rooms.update with a valid UUID that doesn't exist in the DB
expected: updateRoom returns no rows; throws 'Room not found'; oRPC maps to internal error; client receives error toast

title: Tab navigation — switching away from Rooms resets state
expected: RoomsPage component unmounts and remounts; activeFilter resets to 'Active' (default); previous form state is lost
